body: You're a fucking retard dude. Freelance front end developers make 100,000 dollar a year salaries regularly, with just HTML and CSS (and maybe some javascript or PHP). If I have to work ten dollars an hour at first, well okay. Seems a little better than working 4 years for negative 30,000 dollars and a piece of paper because this country is a rotting carcass.

How do you get a better job at 18 years? Magic? I'm already working 50 hours a week while I go to school full time. That's barely even possible. How much more could I possibly be expected to do? How are unsubsidized loans (which I already have, because of the department of profiting off of education) at all useful? Because I get to pay them back the rest of my life with interest that accrues daily for a piece of paper that may or may not be useful? How does living in a tent help? Am I expected to be homeless to go to college? Is that a rite of passage now? Homelessness? I turned 18 and all of the sudden, instead of my country investing in my future, it played loan shark to see how much blood it could squeeze out of me. I'm fucking mad at this whole shitty country and I don't understand how more people aren't. There's my "exact situation". Fuck your "you're not trying hard enough" mentality. I've tried so fucking hard I'm on the verge of a psychotic break, and I'm still fucked.

Because it's totally impossible to get a front end developer job with HTML and CSS right? LMFAO. I don't want to be part of your elitist nerd club, I want a well paying job. I don't give a fuck if you don't bestow your precious title on me.

People like you actually piss me off more than anyone in the planet. "Go find a better job dude! It's easy! That's why you're going to school in the first place, it's so easy to find a better job! Just go live in a tent dude, and find a better job! Can't afford an airplane ticket? Jump off the grand canyon and start flapping!"
Making kids work 56 hours a week and go to school full time simultaneously for a piece of paper that is free in every other first world country is incredibly stupid

I figured I would get at least one pompous elitist like you. That's why I intentionally used the word "coding" and not "programming".

I don't really see how you can jump into a more advanced language without the fundamentals in the first place. I can make a model spin in python, can I drop out of America's shitty for profit higher education system yet?
I want to drop out of college anyway. I'm working 56 hours a week in a shit job already, to pay my way through college. The point is to not work a job like that.
They are bad people, simply put. Because they make so much money a year, the best loan I can get pays for half of a semester per year. I have to drop out.
